x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given unmatched discovered items exist, When the weekly review runs, Then each is matched, created as a CI, or marked out of scope with a reason Given CI data has changed, When the reapply job runs, Then previously unmatched items that now match are linked without manual action
